items.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: the first time I played for money I was 13 years old and we played at Wysocki’s Restaurant on New Year’s Eve in West Utica and it was a bunch of high school guys: Louie Angelini

ctx.x: When you got out and started playing can you recall what kind of money you would have made?

My first gig, the first time I played for money I was 13 years old and we played at Wysocki’s Restaurant on New Year’s Eve in West Utica and it was a bunch of high school guys: Louie Angelini who I think is a professor of music at Utica College—
